player_prompt.intro:
Wi ule wena Muthandeni {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Pa bodo, matombo ya wena aonekana kama '{player_stone}' na matombo ya muthandeni wako aonekana kama '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa nthawi ya wena, khetha seli imwe ya kuwala (kwa ndexi yake ya nambari) na weka tombi la wena kweni.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' weka tombi la wena mu seli 12.

Lengo la wena ni kuunda njia ya matombo ya wena ya kuunganisha kingo mbili za kinyume za bodo (kutoka juu hadi chini au kushoto hadi kulia).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nambari ya seli isio sahihi {cell_num}. Lazima iwe kati ya 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Seli {cell_num} tayari inashikiliwa. Khetha seli ya kuwala.

action.placement: Muthandeni {current_player_id} waweka ishara yao ({symbol}) mu seli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Muthandeni {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') wauunganisha kingo mbili za kinyume!
outcome.draw: K'ekiti yikulu. I b'a k'i d'o!
